title: Bluesky polarity to fifteen-minute return
claim: Average asset-specific Bluesky polarity improves the next fifteen-minute return forecast over market controls.
mechanism: Signed social opinion diffuses into price with a short delay.

evidence.summary: The linear polarity candidate was slightly worse than its primary control; primary p=0.7342 and Holm-adjusted p=1.0.

nextAction: Keep this marginal linear claim rejected; any conditional polarity-generation candidate needs a new mechanism, bounded search, and fresh outcomes.
